result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

**What changed**

- `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java` (`countPerSalesRep`): the count query now adds the existing `NOT_CANCELLED` condition, the same one the quarter, weekday and per-country purchase-order reports use. I also updated the Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces your January example. I also added a status-taking overload of the test's `purchaseOrder` helper.

**Tests**

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (4 tests, including the new one), plus `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest`, `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest`, `WeekdayPurchaseOrdersTest`, `CountryPurchaseOrdersTest` and `DashboardTest` all pass. Nothing is committed.
